描述_EN: amitabha, the buddha of infinite light, is believed to dwell in the western paradise, a pure land where the faithful can be reborn. amitabha came to the v & a as one of a pair of figures, slightly under life-size. he wears floral ear jewellery. his throne is in the form of an open lotus flower, the upper row of petals pointing upwards towards amitabha. his companion figure is a lotus-bearing deity, probably the bodhisattva avalokiteshvara. his five-peaked crown encircles hair arranged in rows of tight curls, rising to a large protrusion or ushnisha, a sign of wisdom and enlightenment. he is sitting in the lotus position, soles of the feet upwards, with hands in the gesture of meditation and a facial expression of deep concentration.
描述_ZN: 阿弥陀佛，无量光菩萨，被认为居住在西方极乐世界，是信徒们可以转生的净土。 阿弥陀佛作为一对人物之一来到V&A，略低于真人大小。 他戴着花色的耳饰。 他的宝座是一朵开放的莲花，上面一排花瓣指向阿弥陀佛的方向。 他的同伴是一位手持莲花的神灵，可能是阿瓦洛蒂什瓦拉菩萨。 他的五峰冠环绕着一排排紧密卷曲的头发，上升到一个大的突起或ushnisha，是智慧和开悟的标志。 他坐于莲花座，脚底朝上，双手作禅定状，面部表情深沉专注。
